gates.name: price-source-required
gates.blocksIf: the plan has paid work and no dated price source covers it

gates.name: budget-required
gates.blocksIf: the ticket has no allocation in budgets.json

gates.name: reservation-within-bounds
gates.blocksIf: estimate plus margin exceeds the per-run cap, the ticket allocation or what is left of the period

gates.name: overspend-acknowledged
gates.blocksIf: an earlier run of the ticket has overspend the owner has not acknowledged

gates.name: billing-pending
gates.blocksIf: the provider has not billed the run yet
